class NumberDefaults {
  format(value = this.amount()) { return value.toFixed(); }
  amount(label = this.format()): number { return label.length; }
}

class StringDefaults {
  message(value = this.text()): string { return value.toUpperCase(); }
  text(value = this.message()) { return value.trim(); }
}

function describe(value = count()) { return value.toFixed(); }
function count(label = describe()): number { return label.length; }

console.log(new NumberDefaults().format(42), new NumberDefaults().amount("three"));
console.log(new StringDefaults().message("hey"), new StringDefaults().text(" chapter "));
console.log(describe(7), count("four"));
